hero.sub: A Vancouver-based AI research studio building products that make ordinary moments better.

who.quotePre: We believe AI’s highest purpose is
who.body1: Metis AI Research was founded in Vancouver on the belief that the AI era demands companies that build with care. Our mission is to revolutionize how people live and work through innovative, AI-powered solutions.
who.body2: Whether it’s personalized learning, intelligent assistants, or tools that simplify complex tasks, we focus on creating seamless experiences that elevate daily interactions — and stay out of the way when they should.
who.body3: We believe in the transformative potential of AI to positively impact every aspect of life, and we’re building quietly toward that future.

productMarquee.tagline: A mental wellness companion — tarot, astrology, and fortune telling in a safe space to talk through whatever’s on your mind. Counselling at your fingertips, 24/7.
productMarquee.mockUser1: I’ve been feeling stuck lately. Can you pull a card?
productMarquee.mockAi1: Of course. Take a breath — I drew The Star for you. It’s a sign of quiet hope after a hard stretch. What feels heaviest right now?
productMarquee.mockUser2: Work. I can’t tell if I’m burnt out or just lost.

principles.title: AI should feel inevitable, not impressive.
principles.body: The best technology disappears. We don’t build demos for the AI era — we build products that feel obvious in hindsight, the kind you can’t imagine living without a month after using them.

principles.title: Personalization is a craft, not a feature.
principles.body: Every product we create is shaped to your actual life — whether for learning, productivity, or wellbeing. Generic AI is loud; personal AI is quiet and precise. We choose precision.

principles.title: Small teams with strong taste outperform big teams with big budgets.
principles.body: We are a small team, supported by Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub, building with focus and conviction. The future belongs to teams that care about details other people skip.
